entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Isn't tomorrow... When we meet with[n]Dr. Maruki?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We couldn't secure our route to[n]the Treasure in time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To think we'd have this much trouble...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm not entirely certain, but... I wonder[n]if our problem's that we really can't[n]deny Dr. Maruki's reality.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, don't be all down like that!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: ...At any rate, tomorrow's the day, right?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: We'll be speaking with Dr. Maruki[n]regardless of the answer.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She's right. We just have to reach[n]a decision by tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's call it a day for now.
What am I going to do?
